prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one new transparent mascot asset for compositing against the RIGHT edge of an existing tall phone on a website. Reference image is the approved identity: same asymmetric three-lobed black cloud head, two white oval eyes, tiny black bean body, short rounded arms/feet, muted blue scarf. New pose: character faces LEFT in three-quarter view, leans its torso toward a phone immediately to its left and reaches BOTH arms left with rounded hands gripping the same invisible vertical edge at two heights, like hugging and supporting a tall phone. Both hands clearly protrude to the LEFT of the head/body silhouette; head tilts affectionately left toward phone, legs tucked slightly right for balance. Design the contact pose so hands are the leftmost opaque points; the head and torso remain entirely to their right. Do not draw the phone: it is an existing HTML object and must remain transparent in this asset. Only the character. Preserve identity and minimalist black/blue palette, no mouth, no background, no text, no ground. Full body, no cropping. Small margins around silhouette; actual transparent PNG. This must be a fresh gripping/leaning pose, not a standing or waving pose.
